{"subject": "Retirement planning conversation for the Voss Household", "body": "Dear Voss Household,

I am writing as your adviser to suggest a conversation about your upcoming retirement on Apr 30, 2027, when USD 1,300,000 in assets tied to the event may come into play. You have been a client since 2014, and our last meeting was Jun 11, 2026, with your next review due Jun 11, 2027.

Your household holds USD 3,940,000 across 2 accounts, including USD 125,075 in cash, or 3.2% of AUM. Your largest holding is Total market ETF (VTI) at 28.5% of AUM, and restricted positions total USD 1,944,160, or 49.3% of AUM.

I would welcome a review to discuss how these pieces fit together ahead of the event. Please let me know a convenient time.

Dana Whitfield", "claims": [{"text": "Apr 30, 2027", "source_field": "life_event_date"}, {"text": "USD 1,300,000", "source_field": "life_event_value_usd"}, {"text": "USD 3,940,000", "source_field": "aum"}, {"text": "USD 125,075", "source_field": "cash_usd"}, {"text": "USD 1,944,160", "source_field": "restricted_usd"}]}
